caption: The drawing is a grayscale pencil illustration depicting an andiron, which is a metal support used in a fireplace. The main object is centrally positioned and features three legs, each ending in a rounded, flat pad, forming a stable tripod base. Rising vertically from the base is a thick, slightly faceted rod with a large, smooth sphere at its top. A shorter horizontal bar protrudes perpendicularly near the bottom of the vertical rod, and is attached by a visible round fastener. In the upper left and right corners, there are two smaller technical sketches of the andiron, shown from the front and side angles; these provide a simplified schematic representation of the object. Below the right schematic sketch is a small inches scale. The background is plain and lightly shaded, and the artist's name, "A. Maralian," is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
